Enjoy yourself with all you've got. That's the meaning of life!

Although what the badge once stood for has long ceased to be, Ernesto continues to keep it on him at all times. We shall never know whether this is meant to be a keepsake or a way for him to reflect on himself.
medal_activity_12side_03:
You now know what Ch'en has been up to aside from participating in the competition while she is on holiday in Dossoles.
This has been a terrible holiday to her. Well, maybe not as bad as she's making it sound.
medal_activity_12side_04:
Thank you for your contributions you have made to the promotion of Dossoles's cityscapes.
The Lungmenites have really taken spotlight here. Perhaps you should take a few more photos with them while they're around.
medal_activity_12side_05:
You have had quite the shopping spree at Mama John's.
The merchandise you purchased will be delivered to your hotel in Dossoles. May I assist you any other way?
medal_activity_12side_06:
You have witnessed Team LUNG wRATh's taking the gold in the competition.
Although much of the prize money has been withheld to make up for all the sunk boats, the remainder of the money should still be enough for the team to enjoy the rest of their time in Dossoles.
medal_activity_12side_07:
You have begun to really 'understand' what Dossoles stands for. It is a city full of 'opportunities.'
If you make a name for yourself here, someone is bound to knock on your door. Taking care of the trouble will get you even more famous. What a vicious cycle.
medal_activity_12side_08:
You have certainly found your place here in Dossoles.
The only way to break this cycle is by proving that you are strong enough, and you have done it.
medal_activity_12side_09:
Ch'en and the gang battled it out with the delinquents that fled to Dossoles.
Oni and Tiger Twinned Stars; Mouse's Courage, Dragon's Might.
medal_activity_12side_10:
With the help of Rhodes Island's field operators, Ch'en and her friends captured a group of diehard remnants of Pancho's gang.
From here on out, the L.G.D.'s name will forever hang over the heads of all Dossoles criminals.
medal_activity_12side_11:
Ch'en and Lin Yühsia can now claim to be big Dossoles collectors.
Of course, as everyone knows, most people become so-called collectors when they have nothing better to do. That's how it usually goes in Dossoles, at least.
medal_activity_12side_12:
Unfortunate, or just bored. Ch'en and Lin Yühsia may have to pick one of these titles for themselves.
Ernesto spent all night forging this medal. The look on his face when he handed Ch'en the medal revealed that not even he could have foreseen this outcome.
medal_activity_13d0_01:
A stamp, carved by an operator, of the radiant light that struck them while they cooled out on the deck.
It's said that from birth to death, it's always the same breeze blowing by your side.
medal_activity_13d0_02:
In accordance with Operator Mint's description, this engraved seal depicts the teethmarks left after a book bites.
Books can bite people? Do books have teeth? Wait, can books even move?
medal_activity_13d5_01:
You witnessed a knight's modern form. You soon witness a knight's fading afterglow.
In this era doomed beyond reproach, even if the road's futility is set in stone, the radiance still shines on.
medal_activity_13d5_02:
You took full advantage of the rules.
At times, for the benefit of their own knights, coaches and sponsors will think of every trick in the book to shake out those luxury-lined VIP pockets wandering the exhibition room.
medal_activity_13d5_03:
You successfully rose in rank in the Major.
You'll find these commemorative medals all over the Grand Knight Territory, and they're very cheap. The 1st, 7th, 18th and 22nd medals within the series fetch the highest prices on the collectors' market.
medal_activity_13d5_04:
Even from the jaws of a most sudden attack, you still snatched victory.
When faced with their executioners, sometimes you just need to give the General Chamber of Commerce a taste of their own medicine.
medal_activity_13d5_05:
You defeated a powerful enemy with some help from outside.
Time was, arrogant knights would never rely on anything but fighting ability. But once the first knight, for victory, for the audience, for the fame and wealth, picked up a bottled blue drink dropped from a drone, everything changed.
medal_activity_13d5_06:
You competed with ever stronger knights.
Once, a group of knights fell to the losers' after the first game of the Major. On a legendary knight's sheer force of will, they won back game after game to finally reach the top. It's a legend furnished by each new telling, but the truth is, those knights promptly disbanded afterwards due to money problems.
medal_activity_13d5_07:
You participated in all off-site events.
They say that if a person had twelve hours in the day to play, they'd still need a hundred years before they enjoyed every corner Kazimierz has to offer.
medal_activity_13d5_08:
You read a deluge of skin-deep media reports. We're sorry you had to.
What destroys the meaning of knights isn't just knights themselves. Every spectator who cheers has a responsibility, and every suit who manufactures those cheers is offending a creed.
medal_activity_13d5_09:
The coat of arms Zofia made for herself when she participated.
A coat of arms' significance has nowadays been worn bare, the original idea lost. But even so, Zofia still spent three of her afternoons carving away in earnest.
medal_activity_13d5_10:
You went on a shopping spree in the duty-free shop outside the arena.
Since it doesn't pay tax to the General Chamber of Commerce, it can sell its goods cheap, and an 'alarming' amount at that. A trap laid by consumerism.
medal_activity_13side_01:
You witnessed one knight seize triumph twice, but this time, she left her laurels on the podium. 
At the end of the long night, the sun rises over the horizon. Before it sets, her blazing light will spread across the entire land.
medal_activity_13side_02:
A badge Iwona designed for herself back when she was still a competition knight. 
The reason most people remember her badge is not for its actual design, but rather its golden luster.
medal_activity_13side_03:
You experienced the 'leisure' life of a Kazimierzian public official. 
For all that is holy, you're grateful that the tasks they assigned you were limited in scope, and that you didn't have to attend any meetings.
medal_activity_13side_04:
You poured a tremendous amount of effort in securing the support of various organizations. 
Amazed by your business prowess, career bureaucrats are ready to weave your feats into management textbooks.
medal_activity_13side_05:
You've reached an agreement with Kazimierz's leadership. 
As you know, the maintenance of this relationship is completely dependent on the principles of consistent mutual benefit and profit maximization.
medal_activity_13side_06:
You've spent some time at Kazimierz's Trade Exhibition. 
Here, the merchandise is not only duty free, but many special discounts are available during the event. As attractive an opportunity as this is for buyers, companies are more than glad for the opportunity to dump their wares.
medal_activity_13side_07:
You witnessed a champion of the Kazimierz Major being crowned again. 
As usual, the 24th Major Championship Medal Set will be released for a limited time only and will soon enter the market, becoming another hot piece in the medal collection scene.
medal_activity_13side_08:
You've experienced the fulfilling life of a Red Wine reporter. 
Writing a report is like cooking a dish - it depends not only on the raw ingredients, but also on whether the master's craftsmanship is pure.
medal_activity_13side_09:
You've learned the tricks of the trade to being an entertainment reporter. 
The headlines should be huge, the photos should be blurry. The content should be funky, and the text should be brief.
medal_activity_13side_10:
You've visited the Alliance's main locations. 
Though the Grand Knight Territory boasts few formal military units, the individual combat abilities of these knights still impress you.
medal_activity_13side_11:
You've participated in an invitational tournament co-hosted by the Alliance.
Few people can beat these pros under the competition's rules, and regardless of the outcome, they're the ones who always stand to reap the benefits.

medal_activity_14mini_02:

Perhaps you want to ask about where those mysterious imaging devices came from.
medal_activity_14side_01:
You stopped the avalanche. 
The winter sunlight pours across the land of Kjerag, laughter fills the air, and everything seems to be developing in a better direction. However, as you know well, the snow will continue to fall, and avalanches... will happen again and again.
medal_activity_14side_02:
You are a true master of snowfield combat tactics. 
The purpose of training each Tschäggättä team was to realize your goals. And obviously, you still have some energy left.
medal_activity_14side_03:
You have gained Her favor. 
God does not exist, but God also does exist. When She looks across Her dominion, not a soul knows whether She will be proud or bewildered.
medal_activity_14side_04:
You've become a VIP of the Karlan Trade Company. 
Even without being personal friends with Enciodes, the vast amount of money you spent at the Kjerag Exchange is enough to get premium suites at Karlan. You might even consider trying to compete with Enciodes, which may not be a bad option either.
medal_activity_14side_05:
You've walked the streets and alleyways of Kjerag. 
You've discovered that modern technology has gradually spread through this small country, and perhaps by your next visit, the entire country will be transformed. Whether that's a good or a bad thing, you can't say for sure.
medal_activity_14side_06:
Your trip to Kjerag took an unexpected turn. 
Or perhaps, that was what you expected all along?
medal_activity_14side_07:
You've learned some tricks from the hunters who live in isolation in the mountains.
Snow conceals many things—conspiracies, bloodstains, and of course... traps.
medal_activity_14side_08:
Your prestige has spread to every corner of Kjerag. 
The people believe that none are worthier to serve as Enciodes's right hand than you, and as both you and Enciodes know, you both are looking forward to your next contest.
medal_activity_14side_09:
You succeeded in containing Degenbrecher. 
An army of one holds ten-thousand at the pass. You should be thankful that she isn't your enemy after all.
medal_activity_14side_10:
Your ability to toy with your prey upon the snowfield is an artform. 
Under your guidance, they may even believe that they chose to walk into your trap, and that you are a mere bystander.
medal_activity_15d0_01:
You understand everything that this prison break stands for.
When even rules can be bent because of the circumstances, what should we remain steadfast for?
medal_activity_15d0_02:
You have built a reputation among the prisoners.
Your exquisite combat skills have even reached Warden Barton's ears, resulting in the bestowal of this medal.
medal_activity_15d0_03:
You have assisted a girl who is lost about the future.
It is hard to say she had almost fallen into the wrong path. The other path open to her may not be one full of missteps, though it is certainly not faultless either.
medal_activity_15d0_04:
You have amassed a large amount of resources via the prisoners' special channels.
You have no idea where they obtained these resources, and you have no idea what their uses are inside the prison.
medal_activity_15d0_05:
You have finished plotting out your prison break.
During the process, Mina discovered this medal by chance. It seems to be the warden's go-to gift for the dignitaries who visit the prison.
medal_activity_15d0_06:
You have successfully assisted Anthony's escape from the prison.
Though smog looms in the air outside, the air here also signifies freedom. This is where it all begins.
medal_activity_15d0_07:
You have ensured the functionality of the majority of the devices here.
You have also discovered that certain models of these devices bear the Rhine Lab mark.
medal_activity_15d0_08:
You have grown accustomed to the clashes between prisoners here. You are even enjoying it to some degree.
Perhaps Anthony should hand his position over to you.
medal_activity_15d0_09:
Much of the prisoners have surrendered to your 'power.'
The crystallization of technology and wisdom is not something that can be resisted with mere might.
medal_activity_15d0_10:
You have overcome the adverse circumstances by taking advantage of your surroundings.
Evidently, when we find ourselves unable to take on a problem with our strength alone, we must make up for it with our smarts. Brains and brawn, both complementing one another in perfect harmony.
medal_activity_15d5_01:
An engraved medal based upon the field operation records of Rhodes Island's operators. Each and every footstep bears witness to the experiences the operators encountered.
Each and every moment, a story unfolds in a corner of the world.
medal_activity_15d5_02:
A commemorative medal that came with your outfit purchase.
This particular design is both cozy and warm; Silence had an order placed on this outfit a long time ago.
medal_activity_15mini_01:
A new avenue of scientific inquiry, in a seemingly uncivilized land. Visitors arrive full of hope, unaware of the revelations of fate.
'Don't do anything rash, Southerners.'
medal_activity_15mini_02:
Ambriel thrust this medal into your hand, thanking you for spending a day at the beach and the dessert shop with her.
Hiding from the scorching sun beneath your shadow was the best idea she came up with.
medal_activity_15side_01:
You've managed to find the owner of the goblet. 
What is inherent to us, as well as to the fate of this land, are unanswerable questions by nature. Anger is useless, fear is unnecessary, so we might as well drink, sing, and keep our minds and hearts open.
medal_activity_15side_02:
You are already familiar with Shancheng's unique geography. 
As the saying goes, you've walked the 'Trials of Shu's Paths'. Cableways and tunnels connect the mountains, and the mountains are integrated into the city. Highs and lows intertwine like a maze, yet the Shangshu people never get lost. And you have already become half Shangshu yourself.
medal_activity_15side_03: 'Once you raise your crossbow, the only things left swimming in your eyes are your sight and your target. But before you pull the trigger, there's so much you've got to think about.' The crossbow is not only a weapon, and the relationship between the tip of the bolt and the target is much more complicated. To contemplate this means that you have grown.
medal_activity_15side_04:
You are generous when paying for tea and wine. 
The scenery in Shangshu differs from any other. With time to spare, you can climb mountains and marvel at the boulders. Without, you can enjoy tea and sample wine. You are extravagant and carefree, and have become well acquainted with the various shopkeepers.
medal_activity_15side_05:
You've left your footprints across the peaks of Shangshu. 
The old shops at the foot of the mountains, the porters coming and going, the timeless pavilions, the new wines, and the countless legends of the ancients scattered throughout the mountains will always live on.
medal_activity_15side_06:
The incidents you've encountered in Shangshu have all subsided. 
But beyond Shangshu, the trend continues. It is impossible for you to stay on the sidelines, so you might as well buy some wine first.
medal_activity_15side_07:
You've imbibed several jugs of Husong wine without getting drunk. 
This wine is a Shangshu specialty, different from Jiangnan's light wine and Saibei's strong wine in that its flavor lingers longer. You are a decent drinker, and those cups that seem to fly in and prance away are no drunkard's illusion.
medal_activity_15side_08:
You've brought new changes to Shancheng's time-honored brand. 
Escort businesses, guest inns... There are always things that have withstood the tides of societal change. But rules are destroyed and birthed anew in an endless cycle. Whether they are now broken or still standing is not always an easy question to answer.
medal_activity_15side_09:
You've reached the summit spoken of in legends. 
When you stood atop the eighteenth peak of Shangshu which was said to not exist, only then did you realize the legendary Catastrophe actually occurred. Every saying, every legend, is but another of the city's masks. Though a mask may change one's appearance, flesh and blood lies just underneath—and that itself is a form of truth.
medal_activity_15side_10:
You finally faced Sui-Xiang. 
All those roars that you heard spanning the millennia may have been anger, fear, or, in the end, nothing more than your own obsessions.

An engraved medal based upon a certain lead seal.
No matter how deep into the abyss the secrets are hidden, they will surely all emerge into the world someday.

The deserts of Sargon are vast and endless, yet Tuye will always find her way back.

medal_activity_16d5_01:
You sensed through to Dusk's field of view.
Once, she said she was merely a habitant of a painting. Perhaps she truly landed her guess. But she doesn't plan on doing anything about it. What about you, then?
medal_activity_16d5_02:
You made your first delve into Dusk's way of the painting.
The next time you meet, she'll bring you aesthetics from a place far above logic.
medal_activity_16d5_03:
From that home in a memory, you departed.
This place's customs, clothing and buildings were wholly unlike the nomadic cities of Yan in style. Was it someone's faint recollection of their hometown, or a phantasmagoria brought about by the wielder of a brush?
medal_activity_16d5_04:
You avoided all possible excess reliance on Nian's items. This is very wise.
Heaven knows what's inside one of these two-step firecrackers, but it's not a normal Originium explosive at any rate. There's never anything wrong with using a little care.
medal_activity_16d5_05:
You used appropriate obstructions to put the Ink Spirits to the test.
It has to be said, if some of the Ink Spirits truly existed in reality, it'd be a chance to change up the presently high-risk, high-barred state of the Originium Slug pet market.
medal_activity_16d5_06:
You turned a blind eye as it broke its own shackles. This was your mercy.
'Free' had never been truly free to be before, and had actually rarely experienced situations like this. For a moment, it even sympathized with you.
medal_activity_16d5_07:
You prevailed over formidable musings.
The name 'Ink Spirit' was one Saga chose. Before that, they all actually had their own names. Er, some of them were pretty adorable—did Dusk really pick them out? That immovable object?
medal_activity_16d5_08:
You traveled the landscapes of Dusk's scrolls, just as Saga did.
The fact Saga escaped by herself is something Dusk has taken to heart even now. After all, Saga's far too young a being. Doesn't it come off as degrading of Dusk's standing?
medal_activity_16d5_09:
You bore witness to an Operator's future.
Lava's already greatly grown, and become quite maturely steady, but she still revels in her additionally earned title of 'Purgatory,' despite it seeming a little redundant at that point.
medal_activity_16d5_10:
You collected a great deal of Dusk's beloved objects.
There's just one tiny little concern. Can you really take what you brought out of Dusk's scrolls, and throw them into a workshop rest assured?
medal_activity_16mini_01:
Going off-course in life, coming to know your memories once more, and getting what you wished for in a different way.
'So, she hit her head 'cause she went into the mines without a helmet, right?'
medal_activity_16mini_02:
A medal awarded to you by Earthspirit along with the survey report, as a gesture of appreciation for helping her organize her important geodetic survey data.
The marks time has left on the lands yet remain, on paper and on our hearts.
medal_activity_16side_01:
You have visited, and left Laterano.
That this holy city has never collapsed amidst crisis is owed to its faith, just as you have always held firm to your own beliefs. Your gait ceases not, so where's the harm in being astray?
medal_activity_16side_02:
You have had a deep discussion with the Pathfinders.
They question, they quest. They are the lost, yet so too the steady seekers of the way.
medal_activity_16side_03:
A handmade medal gifted to Ezell by the Notarial Hall's seasoned ranks.
The moment he began to follow his own heart, unfettered by what had set in as common sense, was when he qualified as a true executor.
medal_activity_16side_04:
You have let the money flow during the Summit of Nations.
The Nuncios have informed you that every guest at the conference will be received with courtesy, and that you may enjoy your time in Laterano without worrying about expenditures. You've taken the chance to thoroughly appreciate this holy city.
medal_activity_16side_05:
You have perfectly handled a great number of affairs during the Summit of Nations.
Transfer of relics, upholding order... Your experiences as a Notarial Hall executor have been far from interesting, and whether you can keep it up hinges on how committed you are to 'the faith and the law.'
medal_activity_16side_06:
You have finally voiced the doubts buried deep in your heart, and found an answer.
In truth, you didn't need anyone's reply. You needed only to ask the question: in asking, you more truly interrogated yourself. About what you hear and believe, about what you gain and lose, about the path you've walked and your way forward.
medal_activity_16side_07:
You have borne witness to multiple counts of demolition on Laterano's streets.
Within the scope permitted by the commandments and the code, every Lateran has the right to satisfy their curiosity, including by demolition of buildings... You've needed some mental gymnastics to comprehend this.
medal_activity_16side_08:
You have taken in a series of events from Iberia's past.
He ran a long, long way, ultimately coming against a tremendous wall. He wanted to know why this towering wall was erected here, and so heartlessly.
medal_activity_16side_09:
You have heard the bells of the Tower of Revelations.
'The bells echoed throughout the wilderness, uniting all the Sankta.' But you know it was someone up there singing a folksong, one that transcended time, one of parting.
medal_activity_16side_10:
You have obtained all usage rights for the 'Gelato Stops.'
Laterano's desserts have you reluctant to leave. Law makes this city stronger, and dessert makes it truer.
medal_activity_17mini_01:
With a great deal of effort, the departed ancestral spirits were finally sent back to the Furnace.
Perhaps this is an omen, signifying that the Soul Furnace's mission is nearing its end, or perhaps it foretells that after embracing nomadic city life, Kazdel will soon experience a profound rebirth.
medal_activity_17mini_02:
Catapult hands you a medal she made herself as a thank-you gift for organizing this beach party.
Just then, a water bomb splashed across your face—and you realize this was her tactic to catch you off guard. You raise your own water gun to retaliate.
medal_activity_17side_01:
You have completed your journey at Gran Faro.
The waves yet beat against the rocks on the shore. This brief moment of tranquil will not be the end, yet there will always be someone standing watch here like a lighthouse. As long as a ray of light still shines, the eternal night will never arrive.
medal_activity_17side_02:
You have a firm grasp of many technologies from the past.
Technology and the future go hand in hand with one another, but sometimes you can learn something new by looking at the past.
medal_activity_17side_03:
A medal that Thiago awarded Jordi many years ago.
When he received this commendation for getting the church sparkling clean, he never would have imagined that he would one day shine light upon Iberia's seas.
medal_activity_17side_04:
Your spending power has left a deep impression on the townsfolk here.
Iberian souvenirs may seem cheap to foreign visitors, but this would perhaps have been unimaginable before the Profound Silence.
medal_activity_17side_05:
You found many lost treasures.
Perhaps these treasures never belonged to anyone to begin with, and the ocean bestows them upon those who have its approval.
medal_activity_17side_06:
You witnessed the sinking of the Stultifera Navis.
The destination of a ship is not necessarily a port. It could be an ideal instead.
It was the final witness to a glorious age, and in turn, you are its.
medal_activity_17side_07:
You used a small number of tools to excellent advantage.
Putting tools to good use is not the same as being dependent on them, a fact often forgotten throughout the course of civilization.
medal_activity_17side_08:
You laid down judgment on the invaders from the seas.
This is a world built atop the principle of natural selection.
Having proven yourself the stronger, you have earned the right to lay down judgment.
medal_activity_17side_09:
You set foot on the beach after the tides have ebbed.
At the end of the billowing waves, will we find dry, arid lands or a calm sea?
medal_activity_17side_10:
You defeated your adversary under extremely perilous conditions.
Man created tools to make up for his weakness, yet you chose to set them aside to prove your strength.
Simply claiming victory is not enough. Perhaps this is what you truly wanted instead?
medal_activity_18d0_01:
You have witnessed a very small portion of her tortuous journey.
Inscribed within her eyes are a great land and an entire epoch. Just as we cannot condense the rise and fall of civilizations in a single word, we scarcely have the words to describe her.
medal_activity_18d0_02:
You cleverly handled the mercenary offensive.
Similar three-dimensional warfare solutions are expensive, and many mercenary companies find that annual drone expenditures are their most pressing problem.
medal_activity_18d0_03:
Heavyrain is coming.
Though she may look like a weak and timid girl, the weapon in her hand will sometimes move faster than her thoughts.
medal_activity_18d0_04:
You've carefully sorted out old files for a certain operator. Will she thank you?
The knowledge and lost images within may not be the most memorable, but even through these fragments, you can feel a hint of a lonely romance and a noble mission.
medal_activity_18d0_05:
You've heard many anecdotes about her.
She's getting closer to becoming a flesh-and-blood 'human.' Only this way can she find her final destination.
medal_activity_18d0_06:
You've watched her travel down many paths.
These are but small threads in the lengthy tapestry of civilization.
medal_activity_18d0_07:
You've displayed excellence in neutralizing enemy drones.
Mercenaries hate fighting those who insist on shooting down their drones more than anything else. It gets too expensive.
medal_activity_18d0_08:
You watched over her, and she watched over the land.
In this lifetime, she tried repeatedly to prevent humans from ushering in their own ruination. But her power is too diffuse, and she requires true followers.
medal_activity_18d0_09:
You've recovered a fair number of air support drones.
'Why break 'em? Think about how much money we save by waiting for them to run out of fuel, then picking 'em up.'
medal_activity_18d0_10:
You tried your hardest to avoid getting entangled in foreign affairs.
The Dominion of Demons has long been a fanciful notion, having nothing to do the traces of any existing civilization, its principles inscrutable to any Arts or scientific research. However, it is by no means the only unknown existence in this world. After all, what do the civilizations of Terra have to show for all their development?
medal_activity_18d3_01:
You spent a few days in this deceased city.
To be able to leave was already fortuitous. Are you sure you want to return?
medal_activity_18d3_02:
You worked hard to restart emergency aid buildings throughout the city.
Is it too late? Nobody knows.
medal_activity_18d3_03:
You heard their song.
Should Gladiia not will it, even the most sophisticated recording equipment cannot capture these special vibrations.
medal_activity_18d3_04:
You collected a large number of records from the ruins.
They cannot fill your belly nor can they make a sound, but music still fills your head.
medal_activity_18d3_05:
You endured hunger that most cannot bear.
This may allow you to hold on a bit longer, but you'll still need to find food as quickly as possible.
medal_activity_18d3_06:
You've caught a glimpse of the shadows flowing beneath the tide.
It is but the tip of the iceberg. Your sanity has so far withstood this test.
medal_activity_18d3_07:
You faced claws and fangs that do not exist upon this land.
You've learned that emergency facilities can temporarily relieve the pain wracking your brain, but you are hesitant to rely on it.
medal_activity_18d3_08:
You have already given enough.
The challenges that lie ahead may defy your wildest imagination. Pray that you will survive until the very end.
medal_activity_18d3_09:
You've discovered the unexpected temptation of giving up.
The utility of the emergency facilities is declining. Is that because they are changing, or is it because of you?
medal_activity_18d3_10:
You fully understood the appeal of those words.
Your nerves have been thrashed raw, but your spirit remains indomitable. Finally, you have realized that it is not technology that can sway a believer, but rather the conviction of a soul that believes in itself.

An engraved medal based on the coat of arms of a certain knight family.
Its champion has finally fallen silent, and the knight follows suit.

The canoe that shall carry you to tomorrow has already arrived at dock, marking the beginning of your next long journey.
Look, tomorrow is yet to come, but we've already arrived! Why not take a moment to catch our breath? The scenery along the way is ever so beautiful.
medal_activity_18mini_02:
Verdant rides his motorcycle through bustling streets and narrow alleys. The balloons held by his 'scarecrow' drift in the wind, mirroring the festive mood of the people.
As he hustles about, delivering heartfelt messages, might he also attracts some admiring glances?
medal_activity_18side_01:
You have analyzed various information about the Afterglow and come to a decision. 
Those who hide their faces are still preparing to make their move, but your actions have nevertheless saved many innocent lives.
medal_activity_18side_02:
You have taken full advantage of the energy emanating from underground. 
The schemers never expected the aging power lines to obstruct their own.
medal_activity_18side_03:
You have provided financial support for an abject musician. 
He understands the preciousness of wealth, but is far more willing to give up everything for someone who understands the value of art.
medal_activity_18side_04:
You have found a large amount of lost drafts, and have sent them to the musician. 
A new melody is forming within his mind. He decides to gift it to whoever sends the most manuscripts.
medal_activity_18side_05:
You have sampled every kind of coffee available in the Afterglow. 
For various reasons, the shopkeeper is often away for long periods, but the coffee's taste remains the same.
medal_activity_18side_06:
You have witnessed a concert that leaves a lasting impression. 
Please leave the venue quietly and do not disturb the long shadows left on the ground by the sunset.
medal_activity_18side_07:
You have rectified the misconceptions of a few prideful people. 
Do not underestimate percussion instruments. Setting aside the timpani, which is often considered the vice-conductor of the orchestra, the humble triangle comes with its own wealth of techniques.
medal_activity_18side_08:
You have precisely identified the opponent's tactics and swiftly defeated them. 
Talent is important, but daily practice and patience are just as much so.
medal_activity_18side_09:
You know the alleyways of the Afterglow like the back of your hand. 
The sunset will not stay forever, and the long night will inevitably come to an end.
medal_activity_18side_10:
You have withstood the pressure that comes with the roar of the past. 
Not many can stand unflinching in the face of the nothingness that threatens to consume all meaning, but you are one of those few.
medal_activity_19mini_01: Life is to be celebrated, though trials and tribulations there may be. Live life to the fullest, and you shall have no regrets. The vessel may die and decay, but the spirit lives on.
medal_activity_19mini_02:
Medal that Bison gave you after completing the workouts, in gratitude for your guidance and trust.
The enthusiasm of youth, honed by trial and training.
medal_activity_19side_01:
You have seen this journey at Trimounts through to the end.
The site is now a ruin due to out-of-control tech, but behind the curtain will forever be an undying force to prop it back up. You need to take care around technology, and be on guard against the powers behind it.
medal_activity_19side_02:
You have defeated a new model of never-before-seen weapon.
When something out of the ordinary is discovered, there's usually a complete system in place behind it.
medal_activity_19side_03:
The first medal Astgenne received upon arriving at Rhodes Island.
If she's determined to break away from something, then she sure will. Life puts shackles on her that defy description, and she can only cut her fetters away and continue on.
medal_activity_19side_04:
You have experienced a day in the life of the typical Rhine Lab worker.
Running up data and getting results are hard enough as is, but your boss always saddles you with unimaginable inspection deadlines. You're lucky not to be crushed with debt, at least.
medal_activity_19side_05:
You have flawlessly handled all aspects of your work experience.
Rhine personnel tell you that this is the simplest a day gets in their lives, workload included. You have decided to leave this place as soon as you can, to return to the office you know so well.
medal_activity_19side_06:
You have witnessed the shattering of a wonderful vision.
What broke this beautiful dream was not cruel reality, but the dreamer herself waking up and coming to. She doesn't wish to tie down those she loves—she wants to send them off to futures further flung.
medal_activity_19side_07:
You have made it to the pinnacle in your challenge against technology.
Tech ought to be a helping hand in humanity's advance, not a hindrance, but people always seem to love exploiting it for strife.
medal_activity_19side_08:
You do not consider Dorothy the true enemy by any means.
She founded a dreamland to fulfill her ideals, and destroyed that dreamland to prove her ideals.
medal_activity_19side_09:
You have seen the rainclouds drifting over Trimounts.
At the end of the wilds lies hope and opportunity, along with danger and misfortune.
medal_activity_19side_10:
You have a staunch will, never perturbed by false visions, no matter how beautiful.
Some might choose to find blessings in falsehood. You have planted your feet in reality and testified to your standpoint.

Engraved medal included with the Poly Vision Museum's Home Screen UI.
A meticulously designed gift, the reward a challenger rightfully deserves.
medal_activity_1arcade_02:
You've collected all of the Hall of Fame Badges in the Poly Vision Museum.
Upgrade step by step, and sprint for the highest score.

medal_activity_1autochess_02:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance outfit.
The blazing sun disperses the haze, its passion impossible to resist.
medal_activity_1autochess_03:
You have fully experienced all Standard Simulations within the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
These sorts of simulations may be flawed, but they are enough to prove the efficiency of team combat.
medal_activity_1autochess_04:
You have fully experienced all Perilous Simulations within the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
These sorts of simulations may be flawed, but they are enough to prove the necessity of team combat.
medal_activity_1autochess_05:
You have put multiple strategies to optimal use in Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
Decision-makers not only need to be certain of victory, they must also have the courage to bear the trust of others. Your performance was perfect.

Medal created by Closure, developer of the Trials for Navigator.
Real or virtual, she will always be your guide in times of danger.
medal_activity_1bossrush_02:

One trial does not make a navigator, but your fearlessness has impressed everyone.

Their muddled ambitions not only nourished the flames, they were incinerated in the flames.

Solemnly awarded to the challenger by the defeated OpFor captain.

Past battles were grueling; you now meet them with composure.

The highest respect for an opponent is to outlast and overcome them.

Nature gives instincts to life; yours is to pick a target, and win.

Algorithms of steel failed against your calculus of the field.

What was tempered in flame is your extraordinary skill.

A gift Pallas brought back from a certain trip.
Human customs, heroic epics – she has a great deal of knowledge regarding her journey that she wishes to share with everyone.
medal_activity_1sandbox_02:
An engraved medal dedicated to those hard at work in logistics researching preparation methods and whipping up large amounts of food.
The tribespeople have been arguing for three days and nights about what makes for the ideal mate: a warrior who fights for the safety of the tribe, or a chef who is proficient in preparing all sorts of foods.
medal_activity_1sandbox_03:
An engraved medal issued to you for researching and developing a large number of tools and facilities.
Life will not let down one who has struggled so bitterly for its sake; if you must give, then you shall also receive.
medal_activity_1sandbox_04:
A medal to commemorate finding an ending that is uniquely yours among the sea of sands.
The sandsea surges, witnessing the rising and setting of the sun and moons, and the coming and going of newborn powers. We are naught but silent grains of sand.

It was designed to address any potential gaps in Rhodes Island's response to a full-scale assault, and you have carried out the mission flawlessly.
medal_activity_1vautochess_02:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol Outfit.
So many threads—where do the clues lie hidden?
medal_activity_1vautochess_03:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol Icon.
A personalized image depicting an aircraft cruising above Rhodes Island.
medal_activity_1vautochess_04:
You have repeatedly promoted your Operators to elite status in the Protocol Simulator.
This simulated method of studying combat performance may unlock even more of their vast potential.
medal_activity_1vautochess_05:
You have fully experienced the contents of the Protocol within the Protocol Simulator.
While the simulation still has flaws, it remains essential for optimizing Rhodes Island's internal and external defenses.

Thanks to your directives, many manufacturing bases have sprung up in distant lands. What they support are Rhodes Island's hopes for the future.
medal_activity_1vhalfidle_02:

Thanks to your directives, even the most perilous environments have Rhodes Island manufacturing bases operating at high efficiency. The troubles we face now are all for the sake of a smoother road in the future.

Cool-colored chords reverberate freely.

A gift from the frontier outposts, to commemorate all the production modules you have deployed. As for the small metal crabs that came with it... Eh, an accident during transport.
medal_activity_1vhalfidle_05:
You have given many operators plenty of effective manufacturing training in Rebuilding Mandate.
Everyone here has the courage to start from scratch, and is unafraid of hardship. We'll use what Rhodes Island taught us to build Rhodes Island!
medal_activity_20mini_01:
Your dim, decaying past lies behind you, while new pressures await in front of you. The new city's Open Books and Shadow Ledger meet here.
'We gaze upon the same moons. We are moving in the same direction. However, we walk on different paths.'
medal_activity_20mini_02:
Before she left the tea house, Kestrel gave you this medal to thank you for allowing her to experience a different kind of joy in life.
At first, she was a bit more reserved, but after she became familiar with the rules, she and her flamboyant personality quickly became the center of attention at the card tables.
medal_activity_20side_01:
Your knowledge of the ins and outs of Zeruertza is on par with the natives.
'You may be a little tall, but it's not like we don't have tall citizens!'
medal_activity_20side_02:
You see a new operator being dragged along by Gavial.
He has spent many years in the world of design, but his career as a designer is only just begun.
medal_activity_20side_03:

The Originium-etched gems you personally engraved have no use other than lighting up.
medal_activity_37side_01:
You witnessed the city's rebirth from the ashes of war and intrigue.
Countless heroes remain enshrined in legend, while the homeland was rebuilt, brick by brick.
medal_activity_37side_02:
You received a firmly written request for a family visit. 
She has left the assembly line, but will never let go of the hammer that forged victory. To this day, she remains watchful and vigilant.
medal_activity_37side_03:
You sat in on numerous parliamentary debates.
'Not happy with the state of things? Come on, let's write to Parliament. The MP from Highbury will speak on our behalf.'
medal_activity_37side_04:
You have finished reading a memoir about Victoria.
When talk turns to sunsets, her thoughts harken back to the streets of Norport and drunken friends bumping fists.
medal_activity_37side_05:
You leaf through the latest proposals received by Parliament.
Some of the letters piled on the desk of the new Speaker are stamped with a family's wax seal, while others are grease-stained.
medal_activity_37side_06:
You helped the workers maintain the smooth flow of goods between factories.
They showed you their blueprints, eagerly detailing plans for future rapid transit systems and quadrupedal vehicles.
medal_activity_37side_07:
You delivered a large shipment of medical supplies to the besieged Londinium.
The scars cannot be erased, and many relied on cheap alcohol as painkillers. Still, they believe the worst is behind them.
medal_activity_37side_08:
You listened to the Speaker's address to the citizens.
If radio waves aren't enough to carry her message to every Londinier, then we must go out onto the streets and deliver it to them directly.
medal_activity_37side_09:
You witnessed an Aslan lay down her crown.
No one should speak of that golden lineage anymore. She holds no divine power, only a sword reforged by many hands.
medal_activity_37side_10:
Working hand-in-hand with the Londiniers, you unearthed many useful materials from the ruined buildings.
Some people recovered traces of their pre-war lives, but many personal belongings remain unclaimed.
medal_activity_38d1_01:
An engraved medal awarded to those who demonstrate outstanding aptitude in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medal_activity_38d1_02:
An engraved medal awarded to those who demonstrate both intelligence and courage in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
The Sanctuary recognizes your quality.
medal_activity_38d1_03:
An engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
The knight comes, chasing a dream.
medal_activity_38d1_04:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medal_activity_38d1_05: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
medal_activity_38side_01:
You spent a long Carnevale in Nuova Volsinii.
Tear away the sinners' masks and root out the evildoers.
medal_activity_38side_02:
You met Crownslayer once again.
'Drink deep of the suffering of the dead and chew on the fury of the abandoned.'
medal_activity_38side_03:
You became talk of the town as you carried your invitation on your extravagant shopping sprees.
Everyone can see that you're too close to La Signora del Carnevale—beware her invitations.
medal_activity_38side_04:
You enjoyed the first public performance in Nuova Volsinii.
The show must go on!
medal_activity_38side_05:
You've experienced the Nuova Volsinii Carnevale from the beginning to the end—I hope you enjoyed it.
New traditions have been added to the old holiday. The city has left the past behind.
medal_activity_38side_06:
You set off the fireworks for Carnevale's grand display. 
'Did you choose these fireworks? Good taste. How about joining me when we light up the next city?'
medal_activity_38side_07:
You took down every last one of your sworn enemies: the Carnevale balloons.
By the way, the decorators are hunting the 'mysterious saboteur' who deliberately popped the balloons. Any leads?
medal_activity_38side_08:
You led the parade on a full circuit around the entire city.
The brand-new floats circle Nuova Volsinii, promising that Siracusa will never be the same as before.
medal_activity_38side_09:
You and La Signora del Carnevale completed the Decadanza.
'Dance with me, while some of the old splendor still remains. Dance with me and in Siracusa, We Mischievous Few.'
medal_activity_38side_10:
You designed a lot of highly praised fireworks for Carnevale.
The festival owes much to your contributions. As such, we hereby appoint you as Artistic Director of the Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio. Sorry, it's unpaid.
medal_activity_39side_01:
You are a true pirate.
What are the core qualities of a pirate? Having no home to go back to? A scary scarred face with a mouthful of sharp teeth? Or is it just an unwillingness to be trapped by the boundaries of the land?
medal_activity_39side_02:
A seal made of bone. It's been clumsily engraved with Pascuala's likeness, along with the words 'Pascuala Empire.'
'You'd better not lose it—if you ever need to do business with the great Señora Pascuala and you don't have the seal, that's on you. I won't be able to help you.'
medal_activity_39side_03:
You spent so much saltfin garum at the salt ship market that its value began to plummet.
There are drawbacks to treating a drink as a fiat currency. No matter how many goods are for sale, the amount a person can drink is limited... It's just too salty!
medal_activity_39side_04:
You've witnessed the journey to the open seas.
People used to ask 'must all Iberians go out to sea?' Now they ask, 'must all Iberians fear the sea?'
medal_activity_39side_05:
Even in the vast desert, you've maintained your sense of direction.
The Salt Flat is as expansive as the sea of stars. While tallying their harvest on the returning salt ship, the crew tacitly avoids mentioning the next sailing schedule. After all, returning safely from the Flat without getting lost is no small feat, and they deserve to quietly savor their success for a while.
medal_activity_39side_06:
You've witnessed how the cruel Salt Flat can devour people in the blink of an eye.
Even the most seasoned crew members cannot differentiate between solid, walkable salt crust and the soft, salty quick-sand. The only reliable gauge is whether the person ahead of you is sinking.
medal_activity_39side_07:
You've witnessed true 'El Dominio del Mar.'
'Fighting the wind and waves' is no mere boast. For a master of this art, the sword serves as a third leg—enabling them to dart agilely between masts. No need to even draw their sword—their enemies will lose their footing and fall overboard on their own.
medal_activity_39side_08:
You've witnessed an astonishing bout of extravagant drinking.
Saltfin garum, fine rum—each bottle in the fleet's stockpiles meets the same fate: untouched for weeks, only to be drained and discarded during a devilish night of debauchery.
medal_activity_39side_09:
None of the many hazards in the Salt Flat can deter you.
On the land once swallowed by the sea and later disgorged, an ecosystem unlike any other on Terra has evolved. However, the ones who know this land best are not the ecologists, but a group of displaced souls about to leave it.
medal_activity_39side_10:
You blocked the cannon's muzzle just as it was about to fire.
One of the pirates' many secrets: the heaps fired by the Saltheap Cannon are kneaded together with fin droppings. As cannons go, it's fairly weak, but no one wants to be hit with its shrapnel!
medal_activity_3bossrush_01:
A medal created by the developer of 'Trials for Navigator,' Closure.
Tempered by challenges, proven through trials. 'Look, didn't I tell you? It ain't that hard.'
medal_activity_3bossrush_02:
A medal made in the image of a navigator who seized a favorable opportunity in the game of chess.
Sharp, unwavering, and with an indomitable will. Nothing can stand in your way.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_01:
An engraved medal depicting the crystal clusters and storms that scatter pain throughout the canyon.
Sin and hatred will eventually crumble into dust, then vanish with the wind.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_02:
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_03:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
You have overcome many challenges.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_04: An engraved medal awarded to those who overcame countless hardships during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_05: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_06: An engraved medal awarded to those who defended the front lines during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_07:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_08:
Engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
The camera focuses in to catch the latest fashion.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_09: An engraved medal awarded to those who dedicated themselves to forging continuous progress during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medal_activity_3crisisv2_10: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medal_activity_40side_01:
Under the full moon in Baizao, you have witnessed so many reunions and separations.
Put out enough bowls and chopsticks to accommodate all the invited guests. If you wait long enough, they may just all show up.
medal_activity_40side_02:
You accepted the historian's family visit application, along with a carefully selected Yanese delicacy.
You have heard from your operators of her talent, her story, and her regrets. Soon, you will watch her write a new chapter in her own history.
medal_activity_40side_03:
You've become a regular at Savors at Yu's and have started chatting with the owner as he picks the vegetables.
You know every piece of town gossip—when the fowlbeast will return from the neighbor's roof, which nursery rhyme the scallion-seller's grandson just learned—absolutely everything.
medal_activity_40side_04:
You were invited to attend a grand feast.
There is no one specific 'Baizao taste'. Instead, Baizao has all the flavors under the sun: spicy, sweet, tangy, salty—you get the idea. Visitors from all over the world find a sense of belonging here.
medal_activity_40side_05:
You helped the author of 'Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture' finish her book.
Some readers see a vivid depiction of Baizao's prosperity, while others glimpse her personal memories woven throughout its pages.
medal_activity_40side_06:
You visited one of the nodes in Baizao's efficient food supply chain and stopped a thief from stealing food.
You seized two taels of animal meat from the thief, perfectly balanced at a 3:7 fat-to-lean ratio. 'Why only two taels? Because I only take what I can eat. It's a crime to waste food!'
medal_activity_40side_07:
You accepted an invitation to drink—and managed to get your companion completely hammered.
At a banquet, a few drinks are meant to lift the mood, but if someone insists on more, you will be compelled to match their zeal with even heartier toasts.
medal_activity_40side_08:
You have taken in the city's thriving grandeur.
There are those who are sacrificed and those who make choices. You witnessed the hidden price of this prosperity.
medal_activity_40side_09:
You listened to your friend list their regrets.
Life is bitter and short; reunions are few, but partings are many. There are also those you shall never see again.
medal_activity_40side_10:
While out on a stroll, you absorb the city's vibrant charm.
The snack shop just outside the Academy gates, the food stand on your way home from work, the luxurious restaurant that caters grand birthday banquets—in Baizao, there is a different flavor for each stage of life.
medal_activity_41side_01:
You learned what happened at the wake on the eve of that Samhain.
May the flame that burns all to ashes become the lamp that drives out cold and darkness.
medal_activity_41side_02:
You befriended the descendant of one who cast aside the crown.
Resolve and kindness are hereditary too.
medal_activity_41side_03:
You recovered the Originium lamps of the departed, returning them to those who still remember.
Take heart, for not everyone is fortunate enough to be remembered in this place.
medal_activity_41side_04:
You heard out the story told by one who lost his words.
Losing his words was the last dignity afforded to him.
medal_activity_41side_05:
You are confident that Na Saoirsí's winter will be bright and warm.
'And so in my dreams I go, lighting bonfires in the woods, lighting the path you trod.'
medal_activity_41side_06:
You eliminated many strange saplings from the Dark Woods.
Would they still grow into plants, if the black mist were dispersed?
medal_activity_41side_07:
You met the mischievous fae of the Dark Woods.
Would they be satisfied with mere pranks, if the sun shone into the woods?
medal_activity_41side_08:
You followed the fire to walk the path of the living, leaving the departed behind.
The elegy that has been sung for a thousand years shall turn to ashes with the rising sun.
medal_activity_41side_09:
You stopped the withered branches from growing out of control in the Dark Woods.
Do not allow them to twist everything touched by the black mist.
medal_activity_41side_10:
Time and again, you denied the purple fire its fuel, until it is extinguished from Tara.
When the sun rises, life will truly begin.
medal_activity_42d0_01:
Upon reaching the depths of the Formulative Battlerealm, this medal popped up after you passed PRTS's assessment.
You are just one step away from a legendary victory.
medal_activity_42d0_02:
After overcoming numerous obstacles in the Formulative Battlerealm, this medal popped up after you passed PRTS's assessment.
Your superb commanding skills were critical to your squad's success.
medal_activity_42d0_03:
Upon being a good collaborator in the Formulative Battlerealm, this medal popped up after you passed PRTS's assessment. 
Cooperation is what gives rise to and sustains civilization.
medal_activity_42d0_04:
The medal that Cardigan brought back from her hometown to thank you for helping her pass the difficult simulation training.
The medal was nice and toasty from sitting in her pocket, as warm as the gentle sunshine.
medal_activity_42d0_05: Under your leadership, Rhodes Island has been able to meet the challenges of any extreme environment.
medal_activity_42side_01:
You became aware of the nature of the Law.
The Holy City still stands post-calamity, and the changing of faith is not up to its founder to decide.
medal_activity_42side_02:
You met Patrizion at a screening of the 'Chainsaw Guy' series and became friends.
He is a gun-knight who guards the Holy City, but also an old man who has gone through all sorts of joys and sorrows.
medal_activity_42side_03:
You became the most popular guest at the Shrine of Nurtury after finding so many lost baby pacifiers.
You even witnessed many of the children's halos form as they began to speak—this is when they become a 'Sankta'.
medal_activity_42side_04:
You participated in a highly-anticipated Nativity ceremony.
It happens within dreams, but also in reality. Does it point towards a possible 'future', or to ruin...? It is yet incomplete.
medal_activity_42side_05:
Be it a rampaging rockhorn or a giant milk bottle spurting wildly, they will all fall into slumber under your gentle voice.
The Shrine of Nurtury has fostered innumerable creatures both living and dead, and it is no easy matter to have them share the same dream in peace. Fortunately, you can touch on their common nature.
medal_activity_42side_06:
Be it a snoring rockhorn or a giant milk bottle wearing a halo, they will all return to reality through your efforts.
The Shrine of Nurtury has fostered innumerable creatures both living and dead, but where Laterano should go ought to be for the Laterans to decide.
medal_activity_42side_07:
The arborbeast high atop the trees grows a halo in dream, and you stay awake in the face of this wondrous sight.
Life is a wonderful thing, one that can never be measured by the confines of common sense. This you know all too well.
medal_activity_42side_08:
You witnessed a different sort of 'pilgrimage'.
It existed in the past, and happened again in the present. Then, the Sankta met the Law, and now, the Sankta define it on their own terms.
medal_activity_42side_09:
You met a mysterious guest in the faded Holy City.
All that happened in Laterano was but the start of Terra's future.
medal_activity_42side_10:
You stopped by a firearms workshop and got a hands-on lesson on how to craft a gun.
The grumpy gunsmith gives you a high rating, and the children invite you to take a photo together after obtaining their patron firearms. Their smiles are also part of your reward.
medal_activity_43side_01:
You witnessed Tragodia's scepter change hands.
There is no end to the birth of more stories, and no one can specify for sure what an ultimate 'aesthetic' is. He only continues on, towards the pinnacle of the stage.
medal_activity_43side_02:
You obtained special permission from Miss.Christine to rub her chin, once.
Fluffy and warm... finally you free yourself from work and sink into this wondrous sensation for a long time before coming back to your senses. Somehow your tiredness has vanished, and you feel even a little excited.
medal_activity_43side_03:
You found mysterious black shadows scattered all over the film set, and the crew was astonished with your finds.
As you look at Miss.Christine on the camera, leisurely basking in the sunlight and happily enjoying her 'afternoon tea', you know this game will probably continue for a long, long time.
medal_activity_43side_04:
You enjoyed watching a play of submission, rebellion, death, and rebirth all entangled together.
Pre-written scripts of the past scatter into the wind, and now he can finally create his own future.
medal_activity_43side_05:
You visited dozens of Wrankwood's studio plates.
You saw not only the champagne and finery under leather shoes and high heels, but also how the eyes of people in different positions all light up when a movie hits the screens. That is what Wrankwood is all about.
medal_activity_43side_06:
Every character's expression mixes together like a montage, and you watch the truest tale be told.
Perhaps at the very end, the lime-eyed girl with dimples on her left cheek will dance freely under the camera's lens.
medal_activity_43side_07:
You lamented how drab and cramped this prop room was compared to the glistening dazzle of Wrankwood.
Here a little dream struggles, and with the tiniest leak of light from the film set, pursues the brightest spotlight on the award podium.
medal_activity_43side_08:
You went through hundreds of emotions and thousands of lives in this drama. Truly a fascinating experience.
Ecstasy, rage, sorrow, hate... The story ends here, but there are still those who yearn and chase after a higher art.
medal_activity_43side_09:
You witnessed a futile struggle happen again and again for eternity.
Fabricated joys and sorrows nourish their souls, and they no longer have to consider their feelings. You know this struggle will only lead to naught, so it's best to leave at once.
medal_activity_43side_10:
The insanity of drama has given birth to a false consciousness in dead matter. Fortunately, you have been sober the whole time.
The storm dissipates, and the survivors welcome their new, true lives in the wastes.
medal_activity_44side_01:
You spent a series of uncanny summer nights in Mitsukue.
Reluctant or relieved, they all reached their end. What remains will gather itself in a day and return at night, at its best.
medal_activity_44side_02:
Beyond profit and calculation, you were granted trust and a promise.
The owner of this azure gaze ceased a long search, passing through old dust to look toward the road you will take.
medal_activity_44side_03:
You collected so many Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken you looked like the most fanatical of fans.
Some people consider others' existence as the light in their lives; and believe the pursuit of that light is worth any price.
medal_activity_44side_04:
You know the city's secrets and alleyways better than any Mitsukue local.
The retro and the avant-garde are endlessly deconstructed and remade, yet you still find the unchanging daily life beneath.
medal_activity_44side_05:
You helped Tooru Moriuchi run his intelligence hub and earned him treasures he'd never seen before.
'And you? What do you want to know? I promise I'll tell all I know.'
medal_activity_44side_06:
You pressed that switch again and again, with the irrefutable posture of determination.
Did you embrace fate, or did fate entice you?
medal_activity_44side_07:
You witnessed a sparse but brilliant fireworks night.
Even a homesick traveler found a diminutive bloom of their own.
medal_activity_44side_08:
You unraveled the decades-old rumors that clung to Mitsukue.
Answers slowly took shape, then swiftly faded. Facts were scarce; only interpretations remained, and people tirelessly wove new tales from the barest threads.
medal_activity_44side_09:
You accompanied an Oni on her final journey home.
At the riverbend of return only abandoned reflections remained, where new rumors had already begun to grow.
medal_activity_44side_10:
Considering the potential casualties, you denied those machines the chance to take it out on humans.
A small deviation robbed those iron frames of combat power, sending them to sleep along the fate you chose for them.
medal_activity_46side_01:
You now know the weight of a heart, and the suffering and salvation along the heart-seeker's road.
Those with desire, those with dedication, those with devotion and reverence, those with the courage to rebel, may find their heart of hearts.
medal_activity_46side_02:
You ran into Elena as she was leading an energy survey team in the snows.
As radiant as the stars, with a heart as resolute as a boulder. That's just how her clumsy, precious movements are.
medal_activity_46side_03:
Your ample function testing and information retrieval was of vital import to Rhine Lab's probe research.
The researcher in charge will put your name at the very front of the acknowledgments. The day it's published, all will know your name.
medal_activity_46side_04:
A riddle, the most basic form of question and answer.
The seekers no longer seek, the questioners no longer question. Rise from the straw prayer mat, and with your two unfettered legs, walk a new road.
medal_activity_46side_05:
You walk among the ruins, the once-gleaming trains still before your eyes.
Resource allocation and time management have proven to be rigorous tests of your ability. Oh, and take care, the floor's slippery.
medal_activity_46side_06:
Distant, docile snow is a beautiful sight. Approaching, tumbling snow is a disaster.
Put down your broom—we won't be able to use it for a while.
medal_activity_46side_07:
You have witnessed a wayward pilgrimage.
The law states that once the Saintess leaves the Vine-Bead Court, she is to tour the mountains of Kjerag alone, using her two feet to measure the weight of faith and prayer.
medal_activity_46side_08:
You walk alongside the trailblazer of transformation. The heavy curtain is pulled back for the both of you.
Eyes that see the way through the blizzard, hands that dig tinder out of cold soil, courage that sets legs walking across the ice. They come together to form the him you know.
medal_activity_46side_09:
You wait within the crowd. Some journeys must begin by one's own hand.
One step, then another. 'Where are we going?', you hear someone ask. Then another step.
medal_activity_46side_10:
Kjerag has no zoo. The animals here are freer than you imagined, and are more willing to be friends to humanity.
Your new friend is showing you how nimble its flips are again. Please prepare to applaud and offer a treat.
medal_activity_47side_01:
You witnessed an Air Expo Columbia that was hard to define.
The big papers all took a guess at the accident's cause, but sadly neither 'marketing stunt' nor 'political conspiracy' would get eyes on the front page. The residents of the autonomous district poke themselves out of their offices, silently watching the 'tree' floating in the sky with pure curiosity.
medal_activity_47side_02:
Don't doubt your eyes. The 'foil-wrapped potato' in front of you really is the Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise.
Arrogance, ambition, and absurd fantasies are crammed into Skybox's pride and joy—that is, his equipment—brewing up the next big bang that promises to shatter the rules.
medal_activity_47side_03:
Congratulations on breaking the winning streak record! These four thousand bottle caps with 'One more bottle' on them will be your lucky charms as you fly into the future.
No need to worry, you're not getting addicted to soda, you're getting addicted to the SKY!
medal_activity_47side_04:
Does it represent contemporary art, or environmentalism? Is what happened on it a conspiracy cut short, or a tale only fowls could listen to?
You have watched it grow from a seed to the luxuriant tree it is now. You may look forward to seeing what sort of fruit it bears.
medal_activity_47side_05:
With your aid, all the exhibits had smooth lift-offs.
It's hard to say if these baubles floating in the sky will be swapped out in a few weeks or not. It's hardly unusual. Just hold on to the memories of novel experiences that make your head spin. No need to remember the rest.
medal_activity_47side_06:
Suggesting your friends familiarize themselves with life in the sky was a wise decision. You have shown how your gaze is locked onto the future.
'Wait a sec, you can't bring such a large party even if you flash your medals! This is Columbia's most cutting-edge scientific park, not a teambuilding funhouse for a pharma corps!'
medal_activity_47side_07:
You've jumped up and down on a small experimental platform, learning that these unremarkable balloons are quite reliable. Seemingly.
The futuristic airships are packed full of eager tourists, while you crouch by the retro area's hot air balloons to warm your hands. Nobody expects you and your 'hand warmers' to break through the Starpod.
medal_activity_47side_08:
You witnessed a few friends of yours light a spark aboard Propeller Paradise.
It can burn everything away, but also inspire hope. While those two possibilities are still undetermined, this park can escape via the flames spouting out of its engines.
medal_activity_47side_09:
'There might just be a flying tree in Columbia's future!'
—Writing on the packaging of a floating botanical unit made by a company imitating Rhine Lab
medal_activity_47side_10:
You have heard the mutters of an elderly Banshee.
In the Convallis, sharp, grudge-filled cries and grieving whistles waft through the air like mist. Lost travelers lean against trees covered in bone fragments, the crude branches at their backs seemingly throbbing with a red-hot pulse.
medal_activity_48side_01:
You met heroes in Athenius and bore witness to a revenge.
The snow on the peaks will melt, and the rivers will flow again, just as new stories of heroes continue to be written.
medal_activity_48side_02:
You earned Xanthos's trust with your wisdom and courage.
He knows the canal inside and out, but is not always in control of the river of his own heart.
medal_activity_48side_03:
You experienced the voting of Athenius and collected many ostracons.
'We express our collective will by voting. It is a fair and just way of making decisions—so long as truth is in the hands of the many.'
medal_activity_48side_04:
Your courage and spirit have earned Minos's approval.
Keep the Minoan spirit in mind and bring it home, or to every corner of Terra that needs it.
medal_activity_48side_05:
Your dealings with the Astynomos of Athenius have helped you understand the ideals and methods of this reformer.
She does not care if she is understood, nor if there is anyone to walk with her. All she believes in is her own direction.
medal_activity_48side_06:
The acolytes appreciate your help in refilling the fountains during your trip to Athenius.
'I keep tripping over myself on the streets these last few days... Fortunately, someone seems to have been refilling the fountains! I wonder who this good soul is?'
medal_activity_48side_07:
On the bustling streets, you have learned to immerse yourself in dramatic performance, and distinguish reality from illusion. The citizens of Athenius are most impressed by your willpower.
We do need hopes and dreams from time to time, though.
medal_activity_48side_08:
You participated in a complete dramatic performance on the street from noon till nightfall, and did so with full passion.
'That tourist really loved theater, or at least they loved the legend of Kereseira. How committed do you have to be to stay through three straight shows?'
medal_activity_48side_09:
You witnessed a perfect opener, a rarity in street performances.
Just getting a full cast together is difficult enough, and you even made sure that the fountains were filled and giving off a gentle fragrance!
medal_activity_48side_10:
'Charge until you hit their shield wall!'
The two citizens playing Palladulis appreciate your excellent work.
medal_activity_49side_01:
You have journeyed all across Yan, seen the summers and winters, and witnessed the sun and moons rise and fall many times.
The years come and go, and sun and moon mark the ages, but he has made them his eyes, seeing the dead end when he opens them, and the mortal world when he closes them.
medal_activity_49side_02:
You met a craftsman with a strange appearance in Baizao under the setting sun. The two of you chatted about your ambitions, and it was late night before you knew it.

Though Catastrophes may boil the sea of stars and wars may turn this land on its head, the fact remains that we stand upon this same deck, enjoying the same moment in this gentle breeze. Indeed, our voyage has already become part of this very land and sky.

Your reputation makes you stand out from the crowd.
