medal_rogue_1_01:
An engraved medal inlaid with a crimson solitaire, shining with an otherworldly light. 
The performance has come to an end, but looking back, where are the stories that belong to us?
medal_rogue_1_02:
An engraved medal awarded for your tireless exploration of the castle. 
Your hand-drawn maps have some rooms overlap while others span eerily across several floors. You suddenly realized that perhaps the castle doesn't want its true nature revealed.
medal_rogue_1_03:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have experienced the duality of possibilities within the castle. 
There is no hope in the left hand, yet the right is not devoid of despair. This cyclical play is composed by the playwright and the cast, together.
medal_rogue_1_04:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have corrected chronology's flow multiple times. 
You gradually realized that the flow of time here doesn't quite abide by the laws of nature, and after several attempts, you've cracked the temporal trap left by the castle's master.
medal_rogue_1_05:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have assembled a vast collection of plays. 
You've gained a deep understanding of the tools of a playwright. With enough time, why not try your hand at penning your own piece?
medal_rogue_1_06:
A commemorative engraved medal based on many operators' impressions of the castle. 
The castle remains, continuing to grow with the collective imagination.
medal_rogue_1_07:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have collected a large amount of the castle's treasures. 
You've gathered enough to open a museum. Unfortunately, many of the items aren't suitable for public display, and are better stored in a warehouse.
medal_rogue_1_08:
An engraved medal awarded to those who've unlocked multiple squad configurations. 
Conditions allowing, you've designed a variety of exploration squad configurations that can effectively deal with the various challenges inside the castle.
medal_rogue_1_09:
An engraved medal commemorating the discovery of the story behind the castle's treasures by multiple squads. 
They tell tales that have been covered by dust, they explore possibilities of futures untold.
medal_rogue_1_10:
An engraved medal based on the knowledge revealed through the castle notes. 
After splicing together the clues again and again, you found a mark that you've seen before, on Phantom's personal belongings.
medal_rogue_1_11:
An engraved medal akin to the badge worn by Shalem during his time with the Crimson Troupe, representing his identity. 
The badges of the failed were cast into the flames where they would die along with their owners. Yet, Shalem still lives, and as has his badge—a dramatic achievement, in a sense.
medal_rogue_2_01:
An engraved medal embedded with azure crystal, glowing with the light of life.
It carries a truth that the land-dwellers cannot comprehend: All life came from the oceans.
medal_rogue_2_02:
An engraved medal awarded for your untiring efforts to explore the depths.
The Seaborn constantly rebuild their homes. One never sees the same scenery twice.
medal_rogue_2_03:
An engraved medal awarded for witnessing two possibilities in the depths.
The divergent thought model of the Seaborn allowed Mizuki to paint two different futures for you to observe. He smiles at the look of surprise on your face.
medal_rogue_2_04:
An engraved medal awarded for going into the oceans and beginning the exploration of the Seaborn abode.
The dwellings of the Seaborn are beautiful gardens, but you must first find the key to the gate.
medal_rogue_2_05:
An engraved medal awarded for helping with Tulip's problems.
Your efforts have improved conditions for the Iberians, bringing vitality to this dead land. Tulip thanks you for your contributions.
medal_rogue_2_06:
An engraved medal carved based on Operators' impressions of the ocean depths.
The ocean is vast and deep. It accepts all, human or Seaborn.
medal_rogue_2_07:
An engraved medal awarded for your collection and archiving of biological products.
How will people view the progress of civilization, as they look back on these objects in a thousand years?
medal_rogue_2_08:
An engraved medal awarded to those who've unlocked multiple squad configurations.
Conditions allowing, you've designed a variety of exploration squad configurations that can effectively deal with the various challenges of the ocean depths.
medal_rogue_2_09:
An engraved medal that records the memories of many operators.
No one has unveiled fate. Your knowledge of how the events developed allows you to observe, not interfere.
medal_rogue_2_10:
An engraved medal based on the theme of a self-completing ecosystem.
Humanity extracts resources from nature by destroying it. The Seaborn evolve alongside nature. Perfection should not be a characteristic.
medal_rogue_2_11:
An engraved medal awarded for your knowledge of the mysteries of the ocean and the Seaborn.
The ocean has its rules, and the Seaborn are not truly perfect. You know their rules. You shall determine their future.
medal_rogue_2_12:
Naturally engraved medal generated after Highmore accepted her own existence, representing her identity.
Humanity gives sentimental value to objects representing major events that they experienced, calling it a commemoration. Highmore's ownership of the medal indicates that she harbors such sentiments, as humans do.
medal_rogue_3_01:
An engraved medal inlaid with silver-white crystals, shining with a pellucid brilliance.
The seeds of fate are buried deep beneath the solidified earth. All things have existed since time immemorial, but now, people can see them clearly.
medal_rogue_3_02:
An engraved medal awarded to those who braved the extreme cold and displayed the courage to explore the ends of the earth.
You've sailed many ships, rode many burdenbeasts, followed in the footsteps of a few wooden dolls, and slipped more than once on the ice. Hopefully, you found all of this enjoyable.
medal_rogue_3_03:
An engraved medal created due to the sheer volume of scientific research materials you were able to contribute.
There is no theoretical framework that can perfectly encapsulate all the phenomena recorded by the scientific expedition team, and nature itself will never ask 'why.'
medal_rogue_3_04:
An engraved medal awarded to those who've unlocked multiple squad configurations. 
Conditions allowing, you've designed a variety of exploration squad configurations that can effectively deal with the various challenges of the icefields.
medal_rogue_3_05:
An engraved medal celebrating you having been blessed by this land.
No matter how special a language might be, it all began from the common desire to communicate with one another. You lean close to the earth, and receive an answer.
medal_rogue_3_06:
A commemorative medal based on the previous reports of scientific expedition team members.
There will always be uncontaminated territory in the mind of the expeditioner. The unknown begets fear, but also curiosity.
medal_rogue_3_07:
An engraved medal awarded to you for interviewing many operators and compiling the corresponding reports.
The essence of prophecy is the results of synthesizing infinite amounts of information. Now, you hold enough information in your hands. Fate favors you, awaiting the day it comes to fruition.
medal_rogue_3_08:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have gradually gotten used to the cold climate and a low-tech lifestyle.
Accordingly, you learned the locals' survival methods. You need not conquer nature, simply to live with it.
medal_rogue_3_09:
An engraved medal awarded to you for witnessing a prophecy of two kinds of fates.
You may have heard the whispers of Sami's will, or perhaps seen the Cyclopes' visions. Or, you might've simply followed the thousands of branches in the forest and arrived here naturally.
medal_rogue_3_10:
An engraved medal awarded for your growing familiarity with Sami folklore and your completion of ethnographic texts.
What has been visited once will be revisited time and time again. You've learned to shift your perspective, and redefine what it means to be a 'civilization.'
medal_rogue_3_11:
An engraved medal that Valarqvin prepared before leaving her secluded cave, representing her identity.
In her distant vision, this medal would be given to fellow travelers who reached the end of the icefields with her. She decided to award it now, and placed it in your hands.
medal_rogue_3_12:
An engraved medal awarded for your knowledge of how to survive in the northern lands.
The journey began tens of thousands of years ago, and did not end in a single day. You have been touched by the shadows deep beneath the sheets of ice, and you must decide how to deal with them within the course of your limited life.
medal_rogue_4_01:
An engraved medal inlaid with iron-black crystals, shining with a fiery glow.
The Sarkaz ancestors and their descendants continue to weave new stories today. Beware—no ending is guaranteed to only exist in the Furnace.
medal_rogue_4_02:
An engraved medal awarded to you, who have tirelessly studied the evolution of the Sarkaz.
From 'Slugkaz' to 'Electrokaz,' you've considered it all. The Sarkaz ancestors in the Furnace highly regard many of these ideas.
medal_rogue_4_03:
An engraved medal forged from the increasingly complex Hypotheses Compilation.
The Storytellers' language grows more refined and their thoughts quicken. You realize that, beyond storytelling, they could fulfill many other crucial roles in the city.
medal_rogue_4_04:
An engraved medal awarded to you for restoring a great variety of traditional Sarkaz stories.
If history is destined to repeat itself, then identifying and summarizing truly meaningful milestones becomes the key to breaking this cycle.
medal_rogue_4_05:
An engraved medal awarded to you for your dedication to uncovering the motives of the Sarkaz throughout history.
In one of the stories told by the Storytellers, you became the famed 'psychohistorian' of Kazdel.
medal_rogue_4_06:
An engraved medal crafted based on 'real events' recounted by multiple Storytellers.
They include certain taboos, which ironically enhances their authenticity; even the ancestors in the Furnace have not completely dismissed them.
medal_rogue_4_07:
An engraved medal for cross-referencing records from various storytellers.
Storytelling itself is a kind of deduction, possibly even more precise than prophecy: the more samples you gather, the clearer Kazdel's path forward, i.e. what to embrace and what to avoid.
medal_rogue_4_08:
An engraved medal awarded to you for gradually adapting to debates with Sarkaz ancestors and envisioning various possibilities.
On the outside, they say that 'imagination creates reality'; inside the Furnace, it really does.
medal_rogue_4_09:
An engraved medal awarded to you for envisioning two possible futures for Kazdel.
The atmosphere had been lively with all these whimsical tales. Then, suddenly, an angry old Lich stormed in, demanding that both you and the Storytellers leave—only to face a humiliating defeat.
medal_rogue_4_10:
An engraved medal awarded to you for recreating many items that might have played pivotal roles at key moments in history.
Sometimes, you notice a flame sputtering out of the Furnace, gently drawing one of these items back into its hearth.
medal_rogue_4_11:
Tin Man's engraved medal, which he removed before stepping onto Kazdel's lift.
It was originally intended as a 'symbol of parting', meant to be tossed into the fire along with some fast food wrappers. Now, it's in your hands, and it symbolizes a promise to meet again.
medal_rogue_4_12:
An engraved medal awarded to you, for having deeply understood how the Sarkaz's civilization developed.
'Kerdakaz,' or 'New Homeland,' is a phrase that might not find use today, but will undoubtedly become part of the lexicon in the near future.
medal_rogue_5_01:
Engraved medal embedded with a rare green jade, gleaming with refined splendor.
Its existence reveals the boundary, but its meaning crosses all boundaries upon the wings of imagination.
medal_rogue_5_02:
Engraved medal awarded to one who has visited the Garden of Grotesqueries so many times, you are ready to act as its tour guide.
You have walked the paths for the ordinary, the extraordinary, and the Sui. You know the Garden in and out—the areas open to the public, at least.
medal_rogue_5_03:
Engraved medal awarded for discovering two variables in the ritual.
The Sui Regulator has clear instructions about what to do in the Garden, but who can suppress raw curiosity?
medal_rogue_5_04:
Engraved medal awarded for crossing the halfway point and continuing your climb towards the memorial hall at the summit.
You have traveled halfway, but you have not seen half of the Garden yet. There is still much for you to discover.
medal_rogue_5_05:
Engraved medal awarded for all the clinking of dropping coins that accompany you.
Future visitors to the Garden will hear rumors about a certain deity who leaves money behind wherever they go.
medal_rogue_5_06:
Commemorative engraved medal based on tips collected from past visitors.
It is nearly impossible to fully explore the Garden on one's own. Only by exploring with friends can one hope to reveal even a tiny corner of it.
medal_rogue_5_07:
Engraved medal that suddenly appeared in your collection room after you obtained a large number of antiques and relics.
It was undoubtedly left behind by another veteran collector. Perhaps he will invite you to have a conversation before long.
medal_rogue_5_08:
Engraved medal awarded for taking the name of Sui and journeying the skies.
Is it truly impossible for the mortal mind to perceive things from a Feranmut's perspective? The first step is difficult, but the rest is not necessarily so.
medal_rogue_5_09:
Engraved medal awarded for inviting guests to visit the Garden of Grotesqueries.
Yi takes in all their comments, be it praise or criticism.
medal_rogue_5_10:
Engraved medal based on the Garden of Grotesqueries's souvenir shop.
You bought everything that 'Idle Retreat' sold. Perhaps you should start a shopping service for other fans of the Garden.
medal_rogue_5_11:
Engraved medal awarded for discovering a clue within the puzzles that Yi set for you.
It is both a Sui Regulator ritual, and a trial of humanity by the Proxy of Sui. Both sides understand the recognition signified therein, even if it is never made explicit.
medal_rogue_5_12:
Engraved medal from that time when Raidian accompanied you in a crafts workshop in the Garden of Grotesqueries.
She is available for duty in Integrated Strategies: Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries.

Past, present, and future converge in illusion here.
We witness the past, face the present, and cast our eyes towards the future, uniting to create possibility.
medal_sandbox_1_02:

Charging against civilization is a centuries-old tradition of civilization. We are simply following that.
medal_sandbox_1_03:
You glimpsed into the past of Arsalan and Sargon.

You obtained a large number of recipes.

medal_sandbox_1_07:
You no longer fear the fog-filled unknowns.
Danger is nothing to fear for the strong.
medal_sandbox_1_08:
You are adept at exploring Strange Territory.

medal_sandbox_1_09:
You caught a 'Consortium of Pincers.'

medal_sandbox_1_10:
You gave the place a makeover with the latest technology.
Technology should not be the exclusive domain of a few. It should benefit the many.
medal_sandbox_1_11:
Your little headquarters has lasted quite a while.
In Catastrophe-filled Terra, the prosperity of a settlement is directly proportional to how long it has lasted.
medal_sandbox_1_12:
You took the upper hand in battles with enemies in the wilderness.
Might makes right. Some rules never change.
medal_stage_complete_01:
The flame known as the Reunion has been extinguished, though some may hide the lingering embers within their palms.
The unspeakable story will eventually fade, but they will continue to devote themselves to it with no fear of sacrifice.
medal_stage_complete_02:
You carved the symbol of the last operator lost. The wounds of the Victorian operation will never be forgotten.
Do not wallow in sorrow. The selfless have lit the bonfire of an era of despair. Let its warmth hearten the survivors as they brave wind and snow.
medal_stage_fourstar_01:
You've fought off the enemies under excruciating conditions.
It seems you make a good team with the Rhodes Island squad.
medal_stage_fourstar_02:
You've become an expert of challenges.
Your operatives can now carry out your instructions with exact precision.
medal_stage_fourstar_03:
You now possess the ability to carry out missions in sprawling cities.
You are skilled in creating advantages and adapting to your surroundings.
medal_stage_fourstar_04:
You now possess the ability to carry out missions in the freezing cold.
Desperate straits are an opportunity, and you are not one to let an opportunity slip by.
medal_stage_fourstar_05:
You now possess the ability to carry out assaults during stealthy infiltrations.
As long as you remain unseen by the enemy's mainstay, all methods are fair game.
medal_stage_fourstar_06:
You now possess the ability to see your objectives through in a battlefield of everchanging circumstances.
Perhaps the enemy is the side that was overwhelmed in your eyes?
medal_stage_fourstar_07:
You've proven your ability to lead operations inside the burning city. 
Self-preservation is just as important as fighting the enemy.
medal_stage_fourstar_08:
You've proven your ability to carry out operations under large scale cannon fire.
The cannon cares not for the lives of the innocent.
medal_stage_fourstar_09:
You possess the ability to conduct combat in contaminated environments.
Death draws a luxurious peace from the eyes of the living.
medal_stage_fourstar_10:
You have proven your ability to break through blockades on the frontlines.
The fog of war no longer blinds you.
medal_stage_fourstar_11:
You've proven your ability to execute operations while encircled by blood and bones.
Without exception, all of history was written by them.
medal_stage_fourstar_12:
Even the most perilous of environments cannot stop your steadfast march forward.
Much like the unknown itself, our fear for it is enigmatic and mysterious. Do not give in.
medal_stage_hard_01:
Fortunately, you've escaped unscathed.
The arrows of Inferno just barely missed you.
medal_stage_hard_02:
You haven't become an ice sculpture.
The icy feats of Cocytus are now evaporating away.
medal_stage_hard_03:
Congratulations, you haven't been crushed into pieces.
The Starfire-like halberd has merely smashed into the ground.
medal_stage_hard_04:
There remains a tiny trace of warmth on your sleeve.
The Draco's flames consumed all in its path, yet you remain unscathed.
medal_stage_hard_05:
The storm approaches, but you stay your course.

medal_stage_hard_06:
Yes, General. The cannon is aimed at the target.
The only thing melted apart was the city's last sanctum.
medal_stage_hard_07:
You have not been eroded by corruption.
But war cannot be averted. Being eaten away by despair is the last faint hope the inhabitants even have.
medal_stage_hard_08:
Dark clouds gather even as the fires of war fade.
The smoke may have cleared, but you have never stopped listening to the distant drums.
medal_stage_hard_09:
You did not suffocate from the thick blood.
However, the blood on this battlefield can never truly be cleansed.
medal_stage_hard_10:
You boosted morale and obtained victory in a doomsday-like situation.
There is light shining upon us, even through this cloud-shrouded despair, until daybreak.
medal_stage_hard_11:
You have revealed the secrets in the deepest reaches of Rhodes Island.
No life is eternal, yet no despair can smother the will to embrace tomorrow.
medal_stage_hard_12:
You rescued the desperate miners from the Army's bombardment.
An endless bounding line, a challenging retreat, a victory for idealism.
medal_stage_hard_13:
As the last mutant falls at your feet, this frenzied chapter of history comes to an end.
The scorched city has become their grave. But even so, cloudberry plants still break through the soil of the drab ruins, bearing orange fruit.
medal_stage_normal_01: You've witnessed a series of tragedies.

medal_stage_normal_11: On the chaotic battlefield, any camp may well be your enemy.
medal_stage_normal_12: A ray of light breaks free from the clouds pressing down on the city.

medal_stage_normal_15: You have seen Victoria's honor and splendor, here in eternal rest.

medal_stage_normal_23: You cross over the edge and gaze into your own eyes after ten thousand years, as was foretold.
medal_stage_normal_24: You lost the one whom you treasured so greatly. Reunion can be cruel.
medal_stage_normal_25: An exhausted mine, a river running backwards. You realize this is an invitation to a 'debate'.
medal_stage_normal_26: As you listen to the grieving land and its rebirth, you are even more convinced your choice was correct.
medal_stage_normal_27:

medal_stage_normal_28:
She rose from the darkness and cast off her everlasting shackles, choosing to return to you.
This time, you will not let go.
medal_stage_sixstar_01:
You have proven yourself capable of organizing your operators for a counterattack in the fog of war.
You do not fight alone. We are with you.
medal_stage_sixstar_02:
You found the perfect balance between Ursus's many forces.
Many eyes are watching you from the shadows. They look forward to seeing what you do next.
medal_stage_sixstar_03:
With your help, the hellhole known as Zelgrad was evacuated.
The roar of the shadow of death behind you fades. The breeze from the forest carries the scent of earth, wheat, and tomorrow.
medal_stage_sixstarpoint_01:
No response from PRTS.

medal_stage_sixstarpoint_02:
You have witnessed cries both weak and strong echoing across the tundra.
Ursus's spring shall end soon. Maybe... even tomorrow.
medal_stage_sixstarpoint_03:
You embraced new life, and deterred the specter of death.
When deep in peril, your strategies might be able to give others hope.
